card.name: Dose changes in interaction advice
card.fires_on: The word reduction after dosage or dose, and nearby words in interaction text about drug levels or doses needing to change (decrease, will, valproic acid). Also fires inside a few long medical terms.

modes.label: Dosage reduction
modes.description: The word reduction right after dose or dosage when advising a dose change.
modes.example: evaluate patients at frequent intervals and consider dosage<< reduction>> of Hydrocodone Bitartrate

modes.label: Level or dose change wording
modes.description: Verbs or drug-name endings in interaction statements about concentrations or doses going up or down.
modes.example: everolimus concentrations may<< decrease>> if cyclosporine exposure is

modes.label: Inside long medical terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of words like insufficiency or pituitary.

card.writes: No clear theme; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the text.
card.plain: It lights up where a label talks about lowering or adjusting a dose because of a drug interaction.
